blurb: Goldbelt Tram is located just south of downtown Juneau, Alaska. Look for us on the cruise ship dock in the big red building! The Juneau tram makes a six-minute ascent of 3,819-foot up Mount Roberts from the cruise ship docks to a height of about 1,800 feet.
